        fftTransform(reD, imD, true);
        int[] res=new int[size];

        for (int i=0; i<size; i++) {
            long aa=Math.round(reC[i]);
            long bb=Math.round(reD[i]);
            long cc=Math.round(imC[i]);
            long totalValue=(aa + (bb << 15) + (cc <<30))%mod;
            res[i]=(int)totalValue;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void fftTransform(double[] real, double[] imag, boolean invert) {
        int n=real.length;
        int shift=32 - Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(n);
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++){
            int j= Integer.reverse(i<<shift);
            if (i<j){
                double tempR=real[i];
                real[i]=real[j];
                real[j]=tempR;
                double tempI=imag[i];
                imag[i]=imag[j];
                imag[j]=tempI;
            }
        }
        for (int len=2; len<=n; len<<=1){
            int half=len/2;
            double[] c=new double[half],s=new double[half];
            for (int i=0; i<half; i++){
                double angle=2*Math.PI*i/len*(invert?-1:1);
                c[i]=Math.cos(angle);
                s[i]=Math.sin(angle);
            }
            for(int i=0; i<n; i+=len){
                for (int j=0; j<half; j++){
                    double wRe=c[j],wIm=s[j];
                    double uRe=real[i+j],uIm=imag[i+j];
                    double vRe=real[i+j+half]*wRe - imag[i+j+half]*wIm;
                    double vIm=real[i+j+half]*wIm + imag[i+j+half]*wRe;

                    real[i+j]=uRe+vRe;
                    imag[i+j]=uIm+vIm;
                    real[i+j+half]=uRe - vRe;
                    imag[i+j+half]=uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }
        if (invert){
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++){
                real[i]/=n;
                imag[i]/=n;
            }
        }
    }
}
